question: In which of the following months is the Tuluni festival celebrated in Nagaland by the Sumi tribe?
solution:
The correct answer is __**July**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Tuluni festival is celebrated by the Sumi Naga tribe of Nagaland.
 
• It is observed in the month of July every year.
 
• Tuluni is a significant festival marking the end of the planting season.
 
• The festival is also known as the "Rice-Beer Festival" as rice-beer is brewed and consumed during the celebration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Sumi tribe is one of the major Naga tribes in Nagaland.
 
• The Tuluni festival is celebrated with feasting, singing, and traditional dances.
 
• It is a time for community bonding and thanksgiving for a good harvest.
 
• Gifts are exchanged, and there is a tradition of erecting bamboo swings during the festival.
